page_title: NAP 2-0 TOR | Napoli v Torino 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Maurizio Mariani is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
90+4' The foul by Ivan Ilic (Torino) was seen by Maurizio Mariani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Napoli will take a free kick near the side line.
90+3' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) picks up a yellow card.
90+1' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Yann Karamoh (Torino) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic intercepts the ball.
86' Substitution. Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) on for Mathias Olivera.
86' It will be a substitution. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) is ready to enter the pitch as Romelu Lukaku walks off.
86' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Billy Gilmour.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Adam Masina as he is replaced by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino).
84' Napoli are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

81' A cross by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
80' Yann Karamoh (Torino) makes a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
78' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
74' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Scott McTominay (Napoli). Easy save!
74' The Napoli players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yann Karamoh (Torino) comes onto the pitch so that Saul Coco can be given a rest.
64' Antonio Conte is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Alessandro Buongiorno suffers an injury and Rafa Marin (Napoli) comes on.
64' The game is interrupted now, Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

63' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
61' Philip Billing (Napoli) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
59' Substitution. Nikola Vlasic (Torino) replaces Karol Linetty.
59' Today's match ends for Cristiano Biraghi who will be replaced by Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
58' Antonio Conte is forced to make a change. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is unable to continue due to injury, Philip Billing comes on.
57' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
56' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
56' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is able to continue to play.
55' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Ivan Ilic (Torino) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Maurizio Mariani didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
52' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and signals a foul after Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) brought his opponent down. Torino are awarded the free kick.
51' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
50' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
50' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Good work from Torino as they win a corner.
50' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner kick, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic reads it well and stops the effort.
47' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

47' A lofted cross from Marcus Pedersen (Torino) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.
46' Half-time substitution. Paolo Vanoli decided to make a change. Adrien Tameze is replaced by Ivan Ilic (Torino).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Karol Linetty (Torino) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Half-chance! Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) plays a pass into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic reacts well to snuff out the attack.
44' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Maurizio Mariani ignores the protests.
42' 2 - 0 Scott McTominay (Napoli) meets a perfect cross from Matteo Politano deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:0.
39' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
39' Dangerous play by Guillermo Maripan (Torino). Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli are awarded a free kick.
38' Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game. One of the players from Torino won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Napoli.
36' Rough tackle by Romelu Lukaku (Napoli). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Torino will take a free kick.
36' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
35' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
33' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) jumps into a tackle and Maurizio Mariani signals a foul. Free kick. Napoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
31' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. Napoli have a free kick.
31' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marcus Pedersen (Torino). Torino force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' Flag goes up against Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
27' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who smothers the ball.
26' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
24' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
24' Torino keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

21' Adrien Tameze (Torino) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Napoli are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
20' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
20' That's unlucky! Eljif Elmas (Torino) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
18' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
17' Matteo Politano (Napoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

15' Poor challenge! Karol Linetty (Torino) is penalised for tripping and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Napoli, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
14' Napoli are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
11' Che Adams (Torino) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
11' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
10' Scott McTominay (Napoli) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Torino in a dangerous position.
9' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Frank Anguissa shows great vision to find Scott McTominay (Napoli) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 1:0.

6' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Cesare Casadei (Torino). Maurizio Mariani saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Napoli, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
6' The referee blows his whistle as Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) was too aggressive in his challenge. Torino earn a free kick.
5' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
3' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Napoli.
2' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Napoli.
1' Saul Coco (Torino) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
1' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Che Adams (Torino) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
1' The first half has started.
Torino will kick the game off.
Maurizio Mariani is introduced as the referee for today's match.
